items.source: By default, the content of incoming Redis messages gets extracted before being passed into the target listener method, to let the target method operate on message content types such as String or byte array instead of the raw Message. Message type conversion is delegated to a Spring Data RedisSerializer. By default, the JdkSerializationRedisSerializer will be used. (If you do not want such automatic message conversion taking place, then be sure to set the Serializer to null.) This class allows injection of up to two positional arguments:
items.translation: 默认情况下，传入的 Redis 消息内容会在传递给目标监听器方法之前被提取出来，以便让目标方法能够针对 String 或字节数组等消息内容类型进行操作，而不是直接处理原始的Message。消息类型转换会委托给 Spring Data 的RedisSerializer接口。默认情况下，将使用JdkSerializationRedisSerializer类。（如果您不希望发生这种自动消息转换，请确保将Serializer设置为null。）该类允许注入最多两个位置参数：

items.source: Note that if the underlying "delegate" is implementing MessageListener, the adapter will delegate to it and allow an invalid method to be specified. However, if it is not, the method becomes mandatory. This lenient behavior allows the adapter to be used uniformly across existing listeners and message POJOs.
items.translation: 请注意，如果底层的“委托”实现了MessageListener接口，适配器将委托给它并允许指定无效的方法。然而，如果未实现该接口，则方法变为强制要求。这种宽松的行为使得适配器能够统一用于现有的监听器和消息 POJO。

items.source: Message listener adapter that delegates the handling of messages to target listener methods via reflection and flexible message type conversion through RedisSerializer. Allows listener methods to operate on message content types, completely independent from the Redis API. It is a more limited and therefore lightweight variant of the annotation-driven @RedisListener approach.
items.translation: 该消息监听器适配器通过反射将消息处理委托给目标监听器方法，并通过RedisSerializer实现灵活的消息类型转换。它允许监听器方法直接操作消息内容类型，完全独立于 Redis API。它是基于注解的@RedisListener方式的更受限且因此更轻量级的变体。

public interface MessageContentsDelegate {

        void handleMessage(String text, String channel);

        void handleMessage(byte[] bytes, String pattern);
}
For further examples and discussion, please do refer to the Spring Data reference documentation which describes this class (and its attendant configuration) in detail. Important: Due to the nature of messages, the default serializer used by the adapter is StringRedisSerializer. If the messages are of a different type, change them accordingly through setSerializer(RedisSerializer).
